tool.help:
## What it does
[PMultiQC](https://github.com/bigbio/pmultiqc) is a MultiQC plugin for comprehensive quality control reporting of mass spectrometry-based proteomics data. It aggregates results from proteomics search/quantification pipelines into a single interactive HTML report with QC metrics and visualizations.
## Inputs
You need to tell the tool which software generated the results, using the **Which tool was used to generate the results?** dropdown. Currently supported data sources:
* **quantms**: `experimental_design.tsv`, `*.mzTab` identification results, and optionally `*.mzML` spectra files, `*.idXML` identification files and `*_ms_info.parquet` MS information * **MaxQuant**: `parameters.txt`, `proteinGroups.txt`, `summary.txt`, `evidence.txt`, `msms.txt`, `msScans.txt`, `msmsScans.txt` and optionally an SDRF file * **mzIdentML**: `*.mzid` files and optionally the corresponding `*.mzML` or `*.mgf` spectra files * **FragPipe**: `psm.tsv` and optionally `ion.tsv`, `combined_ion.tsv`, `combined_peptide.tsv`, `combined_protein.tsv`, `fragpipe.workflow`, `fragpipe-files.fp-manifest` and `fragger.params` * **nf-core/mhcquant**: `multiqc_general_stats.txt` and optionally the other pmultiqc output files of the mhcquant results folder (`multiqc_chromatogram.txt`, ..., `percolator_plot.txt`) * **QPX**: `*.psm.parquet`, `*.pg.parquet`, `*.feature.parquet`, `*.run.parquet`, `*.sample.parquet`
Each file type is a separate input field (multiple files are supported where the module accepts them). The pmultiqc modules locate their files by name, so the tool stages each input under the file name the module expects (e.g. `parameters.txt`); the uploaded datasets can have any name.
Each report covers the results of **one** software tool; select all files of that tool in the corresponding input fields. pmultiqc processes only one software module per report: if several `--*-plugin` flags are given, it executes the first one in a fixed module order and silently ignores the rest, so results from different tools require separate reports (run the tool once per tool).
## Report content
The report contains an experimental design overview, a pipeline performance overview (contaminants score, peptide intensity, charge score, missed cleavages, ID rate over RT, MS2 oversampling, peptide missing values), summary tables with spectra/peptide/protein counts, identification statistics (spectra tracking, search engine scores, precursor charges, number of peaks per MS/MS spectrum, peak intensity distributions, delta mass), and peptide/protein quantification tables.
## Options
The *pmultiqc report options* section exposes the pmultiqc command line options:
* `--remove-decoy/--no-remove-decoy`, `--decoy-affix`, `--contaminant-affix`, `--affix-type`: handling of decoy and contaminant entries during counting * `--condition`: create conditions from provided (e.g. factor) columns of the experimental design * `--keep-raw`: keep filenames in the experimental design output as raw * `--quantification-method`: quantification method for LFQ experiments (`feature_intensity` or `spectral_counting`) * `--disable-table`: disable the protein/peptide table plots for large datasets * `--disable-hoverinfo`: disable interactive hover tooltips in the plots
-----
pmultiqc is developed by the [bigbio](https://github.com/bigbio) community. For more information see the [documentation](https://pmultiqc.quantms.org/).
